advice: Plugins may conduct commerce ONLY for physical goods — domains, subscriptions, credits and digital content cannot be sold through the plugin.
detail: Plugin guidelines commerce section. Consequence: Domain Checker is lookup-only in chat; registration purchase happens off-plugin on our site. Print (physical) can use external checkout now, Instant Checkout later (beta, select partners). Never build an in-plugin paywall for digital goods.

advice: Never write descriptions, titles or annotations that steer selection toward us or against others — fair-play violations risk removal.
detail: Banned patterns: prefer-this-plugin language, disparaging alternatives, overly broad triggering, promotional/comparative tool names (pick_me, best, official). Implemented as the no-manipulation gate in packages/evals.

advice: Request minimum inputs only; never ask for precise location (city/GPS/addresses) in tool schemas — use the client's coarse side channel.
detail: Affects trades search design (coarse area in, exact address only at booking) and print shipping (collected at order, never for quotes). Also: no full-conversation-history fields, no just-in-case context.

advice: Strip diagnostic internals (timestamps, session/trace/request IDs) from tool responses unless strictly required.
detail: Implemented: checkedAt removed at MCP boundary (kept internally); expiresAt retained as functionally required for quote TTL. Audit every new field against 'strictly required'.

advice: Never charge ChatGPT users more than elsewhere — no ChatGPT-specific fees or worse versions of website features.
detail: Temporary discounts elsewhere are permitted. Router pricing must be channel-blind; record the parity rule in the routing decision log.

advice: Complete org verification and hold the Owner role before submission day — verification gates the entire flow.
detail: Individual or business verification in Platform Dashboard general settings; Owner role required to verify and submit.

advice: Ship on a public HTTPS domain with a CSP allowing exactly the domains the UI fetches from — no tunnels, no localhost.
detail: MCP server requirements at submission: publicly accessible domain, no local/testing endpoint, defined CSP.

advice: Allowlist https://platform.openai.com/apps-manage/oauth as an OAuth redirect URI before submitting, or the review flow cannot complete login.
detail: Legacy https://chatgpt.com/connector_platform_oauth_redirect still works for published apps, but the review flow needs the platform URI.

advice: Expose oauth-protected-resource metadata and oauth-authorization-server (or openid-configuration) discovery at .well-known paths on the MCP host.
detail: ChatGPT discovers auth config from these; per-tool securitySchemes declare which tools need OAuth vs anonymous. Our domains tools should stay anonymous.

advice: Submission testing tab needs 5 positive + 3 negative test cases, reviewer-runnable with demo creds requiring no MFA.
detail: Our Phase 11 eval suite maps directly onto this — keep growing tests/evals toward that shape per app.

advice: Serve Streamable HTTP transport (recommended); SSE-only servers face resubmission to migrate.
detail: Forum: approved apps had to resubmit to move SSE → Streamable HTTP. Our server.ts already uses StreamableHTTPServerTransport stateless.
